title: Gilbert's disc model conditioned on the square lattice
summary: We present a new percolation model on the two-dimensional lattice, which can be seen as a conditioned version of continuous percolation on the plane. Let us place a point uniformly at random in each cell of the grid $\mathbb{Z}^2$. These points correspond to the vertices of our graph, and we connect two points by an edge if their distance is less than a fixed radius $R$. We are interested in the radius from which there exists almost surely an infinite connected component.
